scope: Small development readiness check prompted by the requested coding/website capability. Not a general intelligence benchmark. Website checks are structural only and do not establish functionality.

python.name: three_inputs
python.prompt: Write a Python function add_three(a, b, c) that adds all three arguments. Return only the function.
python.reply: A return statement sends a result back from a function.

python.name: new_composition
python.prompt: Write a Python function cube(x) that returns x multiplied by itself three times. Return only the function.
python.reply: A return statement sends a result back from a function.

python.name: follow_specification
python.prompt: Write a Python function final_price(price, tax_rate) that returns price * (1 + tax_rate). Return only the function.

python.name: custom_name
python.prompt: Write a Python function triple_score(score) that returns score * 3. Use exactly that function name. Return only the function.
python.reply: A return statement sends a result back from a function.

website.prompt: Build a complete single-file HTML website with inline CSS and JavaScript. Include a heading, a visible counter starting at 0, and a button that increases the counter when clicked. Return the complete HTML document.
